title: Local Messaging MVP Implementation Plan
scope: Planning package only; no application implementation or execution evidence is claimed.

source.policy: Included byte-for-byte unchanged; source governs product behavior.

milestones.title: Foundation and transport qualification
milestones.objective: Run the pinned Windows host and WinUI baseline, prove real HTTP/3 readiness, enforce local boundaries, initialize SQLite, and qualify bounded image decoding.
milestones.exit_outcome: A real Windows baseline can be built and operated; transport/platform risks are exercised before domain features.
milestones.scope_note: No full domain publish/subscription claim; synthetic probes are supporting evidence only.

milestones.title: Durable creation and ownership
milestones.objective: Create users, channels, sessions, and root text through one durable command pipeline with receipts, events, atomicity, and retry recovery.
milestones.exit_outcome: All creation combinations preserve owners and committed identity through real SQLite and actual HTTP/3 requests.
milestones.scope_note: Targets, replies, images, and subscriptions remain explicitly unavailable until their planned tasks.

milestones.title: Content and query completeness
milestones.objective: Complete stable catalog/history queries, targeting, three-level threads, atomic image messaging, and content API introspection.
milestones.exit_outcome: The complete content model is usable through both API surfaces with bounded query and image behavior.
milestones.scope_note: Snapshot queries are complete; snapshot-plus-replay acceptance waits for M04.

milestones.title: Durable pub/sub and reusable client
milestones.objective: Save/query subscriptions, implement bounded event replay, couple commands and subscriptions, stream over both listeners, and recover with the native client.
milestones.exit_outcome: Persisted content and durable real-time delivery work end to end across snapshot, restart, sparse filters, and slow consumers.
milestones.scope_note: No frontend completion claim until M05; synthetic network proof cannot replace real persisted event evidence.

milestones.title: Web and WinUI feature parity
milestones.objective: Build complete framework-free web and WinUI clients with equal content, live update, identity, and recovery behavior.
milestones.exit_outcome: Both actual frontends run together against the same host and demonstrate equivalent persisted results and errors.
milestones.scope_note: Early native tasks use an already running host; packaged launch/startup integration belongs to M06.

milestones.title: Operations and release qualification
milestones.objective: Complete independent startup/shutdown, diagnostics, safe maintenance, self-contained distribution, workload/fault qualification, and clean-machine verification.
milestones.exit_outcome: The exact release candidate satisfies all A01–A50 and every milestone finding/warning is resolved and reverified.
milestones.scope_note: Release qualification and the final full review are separate gates; neither is implied by a successful build.
